offering_description.value: Owns and leases commercial office properties to businesses, focusing on infill and central business district locations. Its real estate operations also include acquisitions, dispositions, short-term financing, development and asset management.

quotes.quote: Franklin Street Properties Corp., based in Wakefield, Massachusetts, is focused on infill and central business district (CBD) office properties in the U.S. Sunbelt and Mountain West, as well as select opportunistic markets. FSP is focused on long-term growth and appreciation. FSP is a Maryland corporation that operates in a manner intended to qualify as a real estate investment trust (REIT) for federal income tax purposes. FSPâs real estate operations include property acquisitions and dispositions, short-term financing, leasing, development and asset management.

As of, the Company owned a portfolio of real estate consisting of 14 owned properties. The Company may also pursue, on a selective basis, the sale of its properties in order to take advantage of the value creation and demand for its properties, for geographic, property specific reasons or for other general corporate purposes.
